claim.purpose: Reserve bounded incumbent deletion surfaces; no binding or deletion before current D1 eligibility and explicit approval.

initial.title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2] Gate 10D2: approved bounded v1 deletion wave
initial.goal: Remove only approved obsolete incumbent C-SDLC surfaces in bounded reviewed slices.
initial.required_outcome: A measured deletion wave reaches the reviewed target without removing useful code or protected rollback/importer surfaces.
declared_scope: Exact D1 manifest paths approved for deletion
authority_boundary: No mutation until D1 reports eligible=true for current evidence
Explicit operator deletion approval is independently required
Rollback and importer paths are excluded
initial.task_boundary: Execute only exact approved manifest slices and recompute proof after every slice.
acceptance_criteria: D1 eligibility is current and true before binding
Explicit operator deletion approval is recorded
Every slice is independently reviewed and green
Removal is measured against the 90 percent target; retained useful code is reviewable and explicitly justified
initial.plan_summary: Revalidate authority, remove one exact owner slice, prove v2, review, merge, and recompute before continuing.

steps.action: Revalidate D1 evidence and explicit deletion approval
Apply one exact bounded manifest slice while preserving sunset surfaces
Run independent proof, exact-revision review, and recompute removal truth

invariants: Useful retained code is allowed with owner and justification
LoC targets cannot suppress needed code
stop_conditions: A protected sunset path enters the slice
Focused or full v2 proof fails

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove independent v2 remains green after each deletion slice
Recompute exact removal and retained-surface truth

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed with zero additional deletion; restore or repair only the current bounded slice.
review_prompts: Verify every removed path is in the approved exact manifest.
Verify useful retained code and both sunset surfaces remain.
Verify LoC/test claims are measured rather than budget-driven.
